ontologyDefinition.name: UKLegalFirmOntology
ontologyDefinition.description: Ontology layer for UK legal firm customer 360 and case management, defining entities, properties, and relationships

entityTypes.name: Client
entityTypes.description: A customer of the law firm, either an individual person or a corporate entity

properties.name: ClientID
properties.description: Unique identifier for the client (e.g., C001, C002)

properties.name: ClientName
properties.description: Full name of the client or company

properties.name: ClientType
properties.description: Type of client: Individual (person) or Corporate (business)

properties.name: ClientStatus
properties.description: Current relationship status: Active, Inactive, or Closed

entityTypes.name: LegalCase
entityTypes.description: A legal matter or case handled by the law firm

properties.name: CaseID
properties.description: Unique identifier for the legal case (e.g., CASE001, CASE002)

properties.name: CaseType
properties.description: Type of legal work (e.g., Conveyancing, Corporate Law, Family Law)

properties.name: CaseValue
properties.description: Total financial value of the case in British Pounds

properties.name: CaseStartDate
properties.description: Date when the case was opened

properties.name: CaseCompletionDate
properties.description: Date when the case was completed (may be null for ongoing cases)

properties.name: PaymentStatus
properties.description: Current payment status: Paid, Pending, Overdue, or Closed

properties.name: HighValueFlag
properties.description: Indicates if this is a high-value case (value >= £50,000)

timeseriesProperties.description: Allows time-based analysis of case openings

entityTypes.name: Solicitor
entityTypes.description: A legal professional (solicitor/lawyer) working at the firm

binding.note: Solicitor entities are derived distinctly from Cases table

relationshipTypes.name: ClientHasCase
relationshipTypes.description: Relationship between a client and their legal cases

relationshipTypes.name: SolicitorAssignedToCase
relationshipTypes.description: Relationship between a solicitor and the cases they handle

relationshipTypes.name: SolicitorServesClient
relationshipTypes.description: Derived relationship showing which solicitors work with which clients (via cases)

contextualizations.name: ClientPortfolioContext
contextualizations.description: Provides holistic view of client relationship including all cases and financial metrics

aggregations.name: TotalCaseValue
aggregations.description: Total value of all cases for this client

aggregations.name: NumberOfCases
aggregations.description: Total number of cases for this client

aggregations.name: AverageCaseValue
aggregations.description: Average case value for this client

contextualizations.name: SolicitorWorkloadContext
contextualizations.description: Provides view of solicitor workload and performance metrics

aggregations.name: TotalCaseload
aggregations.description: Total number of cases assigned to this solicitor

aggregations.name: TotalCaseValue
aggregations.description: Total value of all cases handled by this solicitor

aggregations.name: AverageCaseValue
aggregations.description: Average case value for this solicitor

aggregations.name: NumberOfClients
aggregations.description: Number of unique clients served by this solicitor

contextualizations.name: CaseDetailsContext
contextualizations.description: Provides complete case information including client and solicitor details

agentConfiguration.instructions:
## Ontology-Based Query Guidance

When users ask entity-based questions, use the ontology to understand relationships:

**Entity-Based Queries:**
- "Show me all cases for client ACME" → Query Client entity, traverse ClientHasCase relationship
- "What solicitors work with corporate clients?" → Query Client (where ClientType='Corporate'), traverse SolicitorServesClient relationship
- "Show me Sarah Jones' clients" → Query Solicitor entity, traverse relationships to Client

**Contextualized Queries:**
- "Client portfolio summary" → Use ClientPortfolioContext to get aggregated metrics
- "Solicitor performance" → Use SolicitorWorkloadContext for workload metrics
- "Case details with client info" → Use CaseDetailsContext to join entities

**Timeseries Queries:**
- "How many cases opened each month?" → Use CaseStartDate timeseries property with monthly granularity
- "Trend of case openings" → Aggregate by CaseStartDate over time

**The ontology provides semantic understanding beyond raw tables, enabling natural entity-relationship queries.**
